<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users cannot reset expired or forgotten passwords, locking them out of the claims portal and dashboard. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap pages: workspace administration (completed), policyholder milestone notifications, task overview dashboard, bulk document upload (completed), and document classifier confidence threshold (unstarted). None of these address password reset or account recovery; the closest items concern dashboards and document management, not authentication. No shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem, so it remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
